about.description: bStocks are tokenized certificates over selected U.S. stocks and ETFs, issued by BTech Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle incorporated in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and part of the Binance group. The product launched on Binance in June 2026 after the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority approved the issuer's prospectuses; each bStock is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain backed 1:1 by the underlying share held with custodian Alpaca. Tokens can be held on Binance, withdrawn to self-custody and used in supported DeFi applications, but the offer is made only in the ADGM, U.S. persons are prohibited under Regulation S, and transfer restrictions with freeze capability are embedded in the token contract.
about.founders: Richard Teng (Co-CEO, Binance); no dedicated BTech Holdings leadership disclosed
about.regulatoryStatus: Issuer prospectuses approved by ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA); bStocks classified as Certificates under paragraph 92, Schedule 1 of ADGM FSMR. Distribution via Nest Trading Limited (FSRA FSP 260000), Nest Exchange Limited (Recognition Order 0072) and Nest Clearing and Custody Limited. Not registered under the U.S. Securities Act; offered outside the U.S. under Regulation S.
about.keyMilestones: 2026-06: bStocks Conversion Terms v1.0 effective (Jun 11) | 2026-06: admitted to trading on Binance (Jun 12) with first five listings (CRCLB, MUB, NVDAB, SNDKB, TSLAB) after FSRA prospectus approval | 2026-07: line-up expanded to 36 tokenized stocks and ETFs
about.entityStructureNotes: Issuer: BTech Holdings Ltd (SPV, ADGM). Manager/tokenizer: BTech Services Limited (ADGM). Conversion counterparty and redemption agent: Nest Trading Limited (ADGM, Abu Dhabi). Exchange: Nest Exchange Limited; clearing/CSD: Nest Clearing and Custody Limited (both ADGM, Binance group). Underlying U.S. shares custodied with Alpaca in an omnibus account.

fees.revenueModel: Hybrid - zero-fee 1:1 mint/redeem conversion; revenue from trading fees and embedded spread/FX on the underlying shares leg (Nest Trading) and Binance exchange trading fees
fees.revenueNotes: Conversion Terms state Nest Trading charges no fee for share-to-token or token-to-share conversion; fees, embedded spreads and FX charges apply on the securities trading leg per the Securities Trading Fee Schedule. Dividends and corporate actions pass through to holders (subject to U.S. withholding tax).
fees.revenueVerificationMethod: Binance official PR (2026-06-12) and the bStocks Conversion Product Terms PDF on binance.com
